vulnerability.name: USN-5651-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5651-1 fixed a vulnerability in strongSwan. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 ESM and Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Lahav Schlesinger discovered that strongSwan incorrectly handled certain OCSP URIs and  and CRL distribution points (CDP) in certificates. A remote attacker could  possibly use this issue to initiate IKE_SAs and send crafted certificates  that contain URIs pointing to servers under their control, which can lead  to a denial-of-service attack.

statements.status_notes: strongSwan could be made do denial of service if it received a specially crafted certificate. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
